headline: Job failed (exit 1) — resume from best checkpoint
notes: cleanup/ folder present — overlap rescue preset suggested.
ECHECK was enabled for heat; set no_echeck_heat: true when GRMS > 30.
config_yaml:
# Suggested resume config (generated by mmml md-system)
# prior job: npt_charmm exit=1
include:
  - presets/dynamics-overlap-rescue.yaml

defaults:
  backend: 'pycharmm'
  md_stages: 'equi'
  no_echeck_heat: true
  output_dir: 'scratch/tip3_physnet_ewald_ir/tip3_90_box_opt/npt_charmm'
  restart_from: 'scratch/tip3_physnet_ewald_ir/tip3_90_box_opt/npt_charmm/equi.res'
shell_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Suggested resume (wrap with ./scripts/mmml-charmm-mpirun.sh on GPU nodes).
# prior job: npt_charmm exit=1
CMD=(
  mmml
  md-system
  --output-dir
  scratch/tip3_physnet_ewald_ir/tip3_90_box_opt/npt_charmm
  --backend
  pycharmm
  --restart-from
  scratch/tip3_physnet_ewald_ir/tip3_90_box_opt/npt_charmm/equi.res
  --md-stages
  equi
  --no-echeck-heat
)
exec "${CMD[@]}"
